text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 429/403s on edge-us-east and unusual header fingerprints detected. Suspected distributed scraper/botnet + credential spray. Severity: P1. Playbook: https://incidents.redwood/playbooks/scraper-wave

alice: I'm on pager. Seeing spike across /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Traffic fanout from many /24s, same X-Client-UA and odd Accept-Language. Any quick mitigations we can apply?

raj: I see it. Pattern matches previous botnet with credential-spray signature. Plan: 1) apply geo-rate-slice to throttle abusive IP clusters, 2) deploy targeted WAF block for fingerprint, 3) enable tarpit for credential-spray signature. Executing now.

maya: Support inbound: ~14 customers reporting increased latency and 4xxs. No enterprise tier hits so far, mostly dev/test keys. Sam is pinging those customers.

raj: Running mitigation commands (live):
```
/run mitigations rate-slice --scope=edge-us-east --selector=ua:BadScrape/geo:us-east --qps=8
/waf apply-rule --rule=hb-3912 --action=block --scope=edge-us-east
/tarpit enable --signature=credential-spray-v2 --delay-ms=1800
```

waf-bot: WAF rule hb-3912 deployed to edge-us-east (propagation ~12s). Initial hits: 8.3k/min, top ASN:  AS46606, AS9009.

alice: Also applying temporary per-key quota for public tier: 100/min, burst 200. Disabling embeddings batch endpoint for unknown API keys from flagged subnets.

sam: Reached out to impacted customers list; compiling list for notification. Estimated affected calls ~12k rpm, 14 customer keys with >50% error rate. Preparing interim status note.

jordan: PM note: monitor SLO impact. If >10% global errors or >5 paying customers affected, escalate to status page update and exec comms.

maya: Confirmed two enterprise keys saw degraded responses but they are on Dedicated and unaffected by these edge rules — filing as isolated false positives to review.

raj: Metrics update after mitigations: edge error rate 18% -> 4% over 6m, p50 latency improving, CPU on edge nodes down to baseline. Continuing to monitor 15m windows.

alice: Good containment. Handoff: raj will own active monitoring for 1 hour. Next oncall (michael) notified for 4319880100 takeover. I'll draft the incident summary and mitigation timeline.

sam: Customer notice drafted and queued pending verification. Will publish in 30min if metrics stable.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATED (monitoring). Assigned: raj. Pager closed. Logs and rule diffs archived: https://incidents.redwood/4319876500/artifacts
